in_marathi.name: Avinaya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Path to the heavens
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avinaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avinaya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Avani', meaning 'sky' or 'heavens'. The suffix 'aya' denotes 'path' or 'journey'. Thus, Avinaya means 'the path to the heavens'. This name is often given to children born on auspicious days or to those who are believed to have a divine connection.
